description:
Investigate and Fix Hardcoded Colors in Server Deletion Flow

The server deletion interface currently contains hardcoded color values that need to be identified and replaced with theme-aware or configurable color tokens.

Requirements:
- Locate all hardcoded color values in the server deletion UI components
- Identify which specific fields/elements contain the hardcoded colors
- Replace hardcoded colors with appropriate theme variables or CSS class references
- Ensure colors work correctly in both light and dark modes (if applicable)
- Verify color contrast meets accessibility standards
- Test the deletion flow to confirm visual consistency with the rest of the application

Edge Cases to Consider:
- Warning/confirmation dialogs associated with deletion
- Error states during deletion
- Success/completion states
- Disabled or loading states of delete buttons/forms
title: Fix hardcoded colors in server deletion flow
